title: Lock
description: Atomic lock with owner identity. Used for the run lock and, separately, for step-number allocation — which EVERY step-creating path must take, including manual creation through the API. Retry-on-EEXIST is not sufficient there: two concurrent creates with different slugs both succeed and both take the same number.

owner.description: Enough to establish liveness positively. Lock age alone is NOT sufficient evidence that a previous owner is gone — a long invocation is indistinguishable from a dead one by age.

bootId.description: Guards against pid reuse across a reboot.

processStartedAt.description: Guards against pid reuse within a boot: the pid must exist AND have this start time.

heartbeatAt.description: Advisory only; staleness is a hint to check liveness, never grounds to break the lock on its own.
